name: Wind · Stock Data
summary: Global stock profiles / market quotes / technical indicators / financials and corporate events
description: Access the Wind stock data service, covering company profiles, share capital and shareholders, market quotes, technical indicators, fundamentals, financial statements, corporate events, and risk and volatility data. Requires a Wind Key; the available service scopes depend on what your Wind account actually has enabled.

auth.credentialPlaceholder: Enter your personal Wind API Key
auth.credentialDescription: The personal access token for the Wind MCP service; stored only on this DSH machine.
auth.credentialHelpLabel: How do I get a Wind API Key?

prompts.title: Company profile and industry
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the company profile, main business and industry of {{stock}}

prompts.title: Latest quote
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the latest price, volume, turnover rate and bid/ask quotes for {{stock}}

prompts.title: Technical and volatility indicators
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the MACD, RSI, volatility and price change of {{stock}} over the last 20 trading days

prompts.title: Core financial metrics
prompts.text: Use the Wind stock data MCP to look up the revenue, net profit, ROE and cash flow of {{stock}} for the latest reporting period
